verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਚੈ ਛੁਅਤ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਛਿਨਕ ਛੋਤ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise paakasaalaa baalaa bi(n)jan anek rachai chhuat apaavan chhinak chhot laag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a woman cooks many dishes in a kitchen but a small act of unholiness makes the food contaminated or sullied.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਸਾਜਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਕੈ ਪੁਹਪਵੰਤੀ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tan saajat si(n)gaar naar aana(n)dh kai puhapava(n)tee hui pirayaa sihajaa tiaag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a woman embellishes her body and enjoys the union with her husband, but if her menstruation is due, the husband refrains from sharing bed with her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਭ-ਧਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਲ ਮੈ ਗਰਭ ਛੇਦ ਖੇਦ ਨਿਹਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise grabha-dhaar naar jatan karat nit mal mai garabh chhedh khedh nihabhaag hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a woman makes every effort for the safety of her pregnancy, but if her menstruation re-starts, there is every fear of miscarriage. She then feels distressed and is called unfortunate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਤੂਲ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੬੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise seel sa(n)jam janam paraja(n)t keejai tanak hee paap ke'ee tool mai bajaag hai ||637||

en.bdb: Similarly, one should maintain disciplined life and piety of actions. But, if even a small sin is committed, it is like a dreadful fire in a bail of cotton. (One small wrong act destroys all the goodness that had been earned.)  (637)
